title: misa77 - a codec that decodes 2x faster than LZ4 (at better ratios)
claim: Show HN: misa77 - a codec that decodes 2x faster than LZ4 (at better ratios)
why_good: A compression codec claiming 2x-faster-than-LZ4 decode at better ratios — if it holds up, a meaningful edge in a performance-critical primitive.
value: Compression sells into databases, storage and CDNs where a real speed/ratio win is worth licensing/integration.
risk: Bold benchmark claims need independent verification; LZ4/Zstd are entrenched and battle-tested.
